acceptanceCriteria: On at least one live Playwright repository, a recorded sample of fixture-module changes reports how many full-suite failures fall outside the narrowed set, with the commands and revisions retained in a build-log entry.
body: V1-2042 (PR #1309) adds an advisory narrowed test set under FULL_RELEVANT_SUITE but recall was NOT_RUN. Before narrowing can ever leave advisory status, its recall against the full suite's failures needs a measured sample.
title: Measure recall of the V1-2042 advisory narrowed set on a live Playwright repository
